task: time-dependent material transport-velocity field reconstruction from projected tracks within one physical case
scientific_scope: Single-case chronological heldout windows; not cross-case generalization and not a validated turbulent-fluid benchmark.

observations.training_particle_selection: Fixed published nested N12/N24/N48/N96 seed47 IDs in every epoch; no resampling outside N96.
observations.reference_exclusion_consistency: The fixed N96 union fixed32probes is excluded from donors before building the single reference shared across all N; changing observation IDs requires a new declared reference and protocol.

target.units: m/s already; do not divide by 10 again
target.field_layout: T,C,Z,Y,X; do not flatten time into independent physical cases
target.donor_cohort: Initial deformable rod IDs, identity preserved after adhesion; do not filter on later Jointed labels or mix substrate donors across material interfaces.
target.donor_exclusions: Union of published N96 conditioning IDs and fixed 32 probe IDs, identical for every N and method. Do NOT exclude the full 25990-trajectory pool.
target.interpolator: Existing k32 weighted local affine fit; material radius0.9h and support7h from native geometry; validate coverage.
target.valid_supervision_mask: material & interpolation_support & ~prescribed; keep ghost, empty, moving/fixed boundaries distinct. Unknown is not solid/no-slip.
target.primary_independent_velocity_metric: Velocity RMSE on heldout native material probes, not only error against the interpolated reference.
target.missing_grid_value_policy: Zero is storage padding only; excluded from loss/statistics and never a physical zero target.
target.transport_validity_policy: Require transport_velocity_valid and finite native transport vectors; unsupported cells remain unknown. No fallback to momentum velocity while labeling the target transport.

temporal_model.required: Explicit time-dependent model and baseline outputs with absolute-time/physical-scale conditioning
temporal_model.steady_fallback_policy: Only a separately declared ablation after temporal-variation and independent-replay gates; never silently replace the main transient task.

model_boundary_information.boundary_values: zero placeholder; never load true prescribed velocities into model conditions
model_boundary_information.prescribed_mask: supervision/evaluation exclusion only, distinct from model boundary tensors
